rationale: Direct sponsor evidence identifies Byrd Ranch Storage LLC as an operating battery project beneath GlidePath Power Solutions, Quinbrook's manager-level portfolio company. No separate Byrd Ranch sponsor mandate, project co-owner, later equity transfer or pending transaction was found.
recommendedChanges: Merge/remove the standalone Byrd Ranch PortCo record into GlidePath Power Solutions.
Preserve Byrd Ranch Storage LLC as GlidePath's 50 MW/50 MWh operating ERCOT project.
Retain 2019 only as the manager-disclosed project acquisition year; do not invent an exact date, seller or transaction path.
Roll Quinbrook Low Carbon Power Fund attribution to GlidePath rather than creating a separate Byrd Ranch ownership row.
Do not treat Habitat Energy, IHI Terrasun, Texas-New Mexico Power, ERCOT, lenders or tax investors as equity owners without direct evidence.
unresolvedQuestions: The exact 2019 entry date, seller and acquisition-versus-origination path are not publicly disclosed.
The exact upstream stakes and any non-public lender or tax-investor arrangements are not publicly disclosed.
